mapper.select: SELECT MOVIE_ID, POSTER_URL, TITLE, MOVIE_RATING, TO_CHAR(OPEN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS OPEN_DATE, OPEN_COUNTRY, RUNNING_TIME, INTRODUCE, SYNOPSIS, ORIGINAL_TITLE, STATE, "LANGUAGE", BUDGET, PROFIT FROM MOVIE ORDER BY MOVIE_ID DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT 'MV-' || TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD-') || LPAD(SEQ_MOVIE_PK.NEXTVAL, 6, '0') FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO MOVIE ( MOVIE_ID, POSTER_URL, TITLE, MOVIE_RATING, OPEN_DATE, OPEN_COUNTRY, RUNNING_TIME, INTRODUCE, SYNOPSIS, ORIGINAL_TITLE, STATE, "LANGUAGE", BUDGET, PROFIT, CREATOR_EMAIL ) VALUES ( #{movieId}, #{posterUrl}, #{title}, #{movieRating}, #{openDate}, #{openCountry}, 0, #{introduce}, #{synopsis}, #{originalTitle}, #{state}, #{language}, 0, 0, #{creatorEmail} )
mapper.select: SELECT MV.MOVIE_ID, MV.POSTER_URL, MV.TITLE, MV.MOVIE_RATING, TO_CHAR(MV.OPEN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS OPEN_DATE, MV.OPEN_COUNTRY, MV.RUNNING_TIME, MV.INTRODUCE, MV.SYNOPSIS, MV.ORIGINAL_TITLE, MV.STATE, MV."LANGUAGE", MV.BUDGET, MV.PROFIT, M.NAME, TO_CHAR(M.REGIST_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS REGIST_DATE FROM MOVIE MV INNER JOIN MEMBERS M ON MV.CREATOR_EMAIL = M.EMAIL WHERE M.MOVIE_ID = #{_parameter}
